messages:
maria: Quick shoutout — huge thanks to @jon, @sophie, and @ops_lee for saving yesterday's client demo. The latency regression fix and the hotpatch were 👏👏

jon: Glad it worked, maria. @ops_lee found the stack trace, sophie wrote the rollback script, I pushed the tiny fix.

ops_lee: Haha thanks — just coffee + adrenaline. :coffee: Also shoutout to @nate for staying on call.

sophie: Team effort. Also props to @dev-bot for noisy deploy alerts that actually helped 🤖

nate: 10/10 would stay on call again :laughing: Also requesting cookies for the on-call heroes. Anyone in SF office?

maria: @meredith (People Ops) can we arrange a cookie drop? @sophie, @jon, @ops_lee, @nate — treating you lol

meredith: Happy to! I'll coordinate. DMing for dietary prefs. :sparkles: 

jon: yes pls — gluten-free ok for me. TY everyone.

sophie: i'll take whatever, will wave a flag at the office. :raised_hands: 

ops_lee: can we put a tiny thank-you note on the whiteboard near 3rd floor kitchen? feels wholesome.

dev-bot: deploy-monitor: PROD latency alert at 2025-07-12T21:12:08Z — resolved. (automated)

maria: adding a small note here — y'all rock. :heart: Let's do 2pm cookie drop Friday?

nate: 2pm works. I'll bring maybe kombucha too. :beverage_box: 

sophie: Love it. Also small follow-up: copying the rollback steps to the runbook now.

jon: also adding a short postmortem bullet to #postmortems so we capture the thing.

maria: perfect. Quick poll: emoji for celebration? :partyparrot: or :confetti_ball: vote!

ops_lee: :confetti_ball:

nate: :partyparrot:

sophie: :confetti_ball:

jon: :partyparrot:

meredith: :confetti_ball:

maria: :confetti_ball: wins! Thanks team. 🙌
